61ed293c: This line handles various checks and actions related to data entry and validation. It checks if a certain condition is met (DG array is defined and has more than 9 entries). If so, it calls the routine F^DIE17 to perform data entry/editing operations. It then sets Y to a specific value (U), assigns 16 to DQ, and calls the X16 routine. If the DIEFIRE variable is defined and has a specific value, it calls the FIREREC^DIE17 routine. It then performs some checks on Y and branches to different labels (A or OUT^DIE17) based on the value of Y. It also sets some variables like X, DIC(0), and DW.

cb00e129: This line appears to be setting a variable DGX based on certain conditions. It starts by assigning the value of DGJTXX to DGX. Then, it checks if the DGX entry exists in the ^SC global and if it has a value at the 42nd node. If so, it retrieves a specific piece of data (3rd piece) from the 0th node of the 42nd node in the DIC(42 global and assigns it to DGX. If the entry exists in ^SC but not at the 42nd node, it retrieves the 8th piece of the 0th node from the ^SC global and assigns it to DGX. If neither condition is met, it sets DGX to an empty string. Finally, it checks if DGX is an empty string, and if so, it sets DGX to 0.
